partner_result_applied.result: exact Gaussian heat-height identity for arbitrary probability laws

new_result.name: countable Gaussian heat certificate
new_result.statement: For every probability law mu, with epsilon_k=2^{-k} and h_k=2^{-3k}, the bounded-density height D(mu) equals sup_{k>=1,m in Z} (mu*gamma_{epsilon_k})(m h_k), with +infinity if no bounded density exists.
new_result.target_consequence: The full QFORM bounded-density conjecture with constant C is exactly equivalent to bounding E gamma_{2^{-k}}(X^T A X-m2^{-3k}) by C for every admissible instance and all integers k>=1,m.

unresolved_implication: Uniformly bound the countable positive Gaussian expectations over all admissible matrices and cap-one product laws without rotating independence or paying reciprocal tiny-minor/worst-fiber costs.
next_step: Apply grouped-coordinate or ridge aggregation directly to one fixed lattice heat functional and keep the bound uniform in k,m.
